name: s1-web-generation
title: S1 web generation pipeline (Qianwen text + image writes a single-file page)
description: Real generation for WEB projects: two paid Qianwen chat calls (structure plan, then the page) plus an optional hero image, local validation (single file, no external assets, size cap), an immutable GENERATED version with index.html, SSE step log in the chat page, and an honest failure when the account has not purchased the model.
creator: admin
notes: Switched from Ark to the Qianwen gateway (text + image) at the user's request; Ark keeps only video. Text model qwen-plus and image model qwen-image-3.0 both worked early in the session (real page with an inlined base64 hero produced), then the account's every text/image model began answering AccessDenied.Unpurchased (free quota exhausted), so runs now honestly fail with PROVIDER_MODEL_NOT_ACTIVATED until the account is topped up. No code change is needed once purchased. Multi-turn editing, structured file operations and build/browser smoke are still out of scope.
